head.text: WF-003 OP-003 I2S transmit frame, master (success)

foot.text: Cell = one bit clock, divider 2, two 8-bit slots (legal minimum), words 0xC3 and 0x5A. The frame sync falls one bit before the MSB; data and frame sync change at the launch edge (bit clock falling); the word is popped (w_pop_slot) in the bit cell before its launch. Simulated, synthesis branch.
